Additionally, whether in casual conversation or if you are involved in a negotiation, whenever a creature insults you, you must either spend a Recovery or be compelled to reply with an insult.

complications.name: Wrongly Imprisoned
complications.description: You spent many years imprisoned for a crime you didn’t commit. During your long hours of solitary confinement, you honed your skills and you recited the names of those who framed you. Someday you will have your revenge.

features.name: Wrongly Imprisoned Drawback
features.description: Your health suffered in prison. Whenever you are winded, you are stricken with a hacking cough that makes it impossible for you to hide or sneak.

environments.name: Nomadic
environments.description: A nomadic culture travels from place to place to survive.

environments.name: Rural
environments.description: A rural culture is one located in a town, village, or smaller settled enclave.

environments.name: Secluded
environments.description: A secluded culture is based in one relatively close-quarters structure — a building, a cavern, and so forth — and interacts with other cultures only rarely.

environments.name: Urban
environments.description: An urban culture is always centered in a city.

environments.name: Wilderness
environments.description: A wilderness culture doesn’t try to tame the terrain in which its people live, whether desert, forest, swamp, tundra, ocean, or more exotic climes.

organizations.name: Bureaucratic
organizations.description: Bureaucratic cultures are steeped in official leadership and formally recorded laws.

organizations.name: Communal
organizations.description: A communal culture is a place where all members of the culture are considered equal.

upbringings.name: Academic
upbringings.description: Your hero was raised by people who collect, study, and share books and other records.

upbringings.name: Creative
upbringings.description: A hero with a creative upbringing was raised among folk who create art or other works valuable enough to trade.

upbringings.name: Lawless
upbringings.description: Your hero grew up among folk who performed activities that other people — whether within or outside their culture — considered unlawful.

upbringings.name: Labor
upbringings.description: Your hero came of age in a culture where people labored for a living.

upbringings.name: Martial
upbringings.description: A hero with a martial upbringing was raised by warriors.

upbringings.name: Noble
upbringings.description: Your hero grew up among leaders who rule over others and play the games of politics to maintain power.

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.description: Make bombs and potions.

skills.name: Architecture
skills.description: Create buildings and vehicles.

skills.name: Blacksmithing
skills.description: Forge metal armor and weapons.

skills.name: Carpentry
skills.description: Create items out of wood.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.description: Create delicious dishes.

skills.name: Fletching
skills.description: Make ranged weapons and ammunition.

skills.name: Forgery
skills.description: Create false badges, documents, and other items.

skills.name: Jewelry
skills.description: Create bracelets, crowns, rings, and other jewelry.

skills.name: Mechanics
skills.description: Build machines and clockwork items.

skills.name: Tailoring
skills.description: Craft cloth and leather clothing.

skills.name: Climb
skills.description: Move up vertical surfaces.

skills.name: Drive
skills.description: Control vehicles.

skills.name: Endurance
skills.description: Remain engaged in strenuous activity over a long period of time.

skills.name: Gymnastics
skills.description: Move across unsteady or narrow surfaces, and tumble.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: Use mundane first aid.

skills.name: Jump
skills.description: Leap vertical and horizontal distances.

skills.name: Lift
skills.description: Pick up, carry, and throw heavy objects.

skills.name: Navigate
skills.description: Read a map and travel without becoming lost.

skills.name: Ride
skills.description: Ride and control a mount who isn’t sapient, such as a horse.

skills.name: Swim
skills.description: Move through deep liquid.

skills.name: Brag
skills.description: Impress others with stories of your deeds.

skills.name: Empathize
skills.description: Relate to someone on a personal level.

skills.name: Flirt
skills.description: Attract romantic attention from someone.

skills.name: Gamble
skills.description: Make bets with others.

skills.name: Handle Animals
skills.description: Interact with animal wildlife that isn’t sapient.

skills.name: Interrogate
skills.description: Obtain information from a creature withholding it.

skills.name: Intimidate
skills.description: Awe or scare a creature.

skills.name: Lead
skills.description: Inspire people to action.

skills.name: Lie
skills.description: Convince someone that a falsehood is true.

skills.name: Music
skills.description: Perform music vocally or with an instrument.

skills.name: Perform
skills.description: Engage in dance, oratory, acting, or some other physical performance.

skills.name: Persuade
skills.description: Convince someone to agree with you through use of your charms and grace.

skills.name: Read Person
skills.description: Read the emotions and body language of other creatures.

skills.name: Alertness
skills.description: Intuitively sense the details of your surroundings.

skills.name: Conceal Object
skills.description: Hide an object on your person or in your environment.

skills.name: Disguise
skills.description: Change your appearance to look like a different person.

skills.name: Eavesdrop
skills.description: Actively listen to something that is hard to hear, such as a whispered conversation through a door.

skills.name: Escape Artist
skills.description: Escape from bonds such as rope or manacles.

skills.name: Hide
skills.description: Conceal yourself from others’ observation.

skills.name: Pick Lock
skills.description: Open a lock without using the key.

skills.name: Pick Pocket
skills.description: Steal an item that another person wears or carries without them noticing.

skills.name: Sabotage
skills.description: Disable a mechanical device such as a trap.

skills.name: Search
skills.description: Actively search an environment for important details and items.

skills.name: Sneak
skills.description: Move silently.

skills.name: Track
skills.description: Follow a trail that another creature has left behind.

skills.name: Culture
skills.description: Knowing about a culture’s customs, folktales, and taboos.

skills.name: Criminal Underworld
skills.description: Knowing about criminal organizations, their crimes, their relationships, and their leaders.

skills.name: History
skills.description: Knowing about significant past events.

skills.name: Magic
skills.description: Knowing about magical places, spells, rituals, items, and phenomena.

skills.name: Monsters
skills.description: Knowing monster ecology, strengths, and weaknesses.

skills.name: Nature
skills.description: Knowing about natural flora, fauna, and weather.

skills.name: Psionics
skills.description: Knowing about psionic places, spells, rituals, items, and phenomena.

skills.name: Religion
skills.description: Knowing about religious mythology, practices, and rituals.

skills.name: Rumors
skills.description: Knowing gossip, legends, and uncertain truths.

skills.name: Society
skills.description: Knowing noble etiquette and the leadership and power dynamics of noble families.

skills.name: Strategy
skills.description: Knowing about battle tactics and logistics.

skills.name: Timescape
skills.description: Knowing about the various planets of the timescape

languages.name: Caelian
languages.description: The language of the ancient Caelian Empire; the common tongue of Orden.

languages.name: Khoursirian
languages.description: Spoken in Khoursir; a distant offshoot of Khamish.

languages.name: Anjali
languages.description: Spoken in the Hells; the language of contract law.

languages.name: Axiomatic
languages.description: Spoken by Memoneks; native language of Axiom; the common language of the timescape by trade.

languages.name: Filliaric
languages.description: Spoken by Angulotls; an offshoot of Cyllinric.

languages.name: The First Language
languages.description: Spoken by elder dragons; the language of magic.

languages.name: High Kuric
languages.description: Spoken by bredbeddles, giants, ogres, and trolls.

languages.name: Hyrallic

elementalist.name: Elementalist
elementalist.description:
Air for movement. Earth for permanence. Fire for destruction. Water for change. Green for growth. Rot for death. Void for the mystery. Years of study and practice and poring over tomes brought you the revelations that allow you to manipulate these building blocks of reality. Now you use your mastery of the seven elements to destroy, create, and warp the world with magic.

As an elementalist, you can unleash your wrath across a field of foes, put an enemy exactly where you want them, debilitate foes with harmful effects, ward yourself and allies against danger, manipulate terrain, warp space, and more. Your choice of elemental specialization determines which of these things you do best.

gains.trigger: You or a creature within 10 of you takes damage that isn’t untyped or holy

ability.name: Hurl Element
ability.description: You hurl a ball of elemental energy at an unsuspecting foe.

qualifiers: can be used as a ranged free strike

args: When you make this strike, choose the damage type from one of the following options: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic.

features.name: Persistent Magic
features.description:
Some of your heroic abilities have a persistent effect entry. For example, the Instantaneous Excavation ability has an effect noted as “Persistent 1.” Whenever you use a persistent ability, you decide whether you want to maintain it, and start doing so immediately after you first use the ability. If you maintain a persistent ability in combat, you reduce the amount of essence you earn at the start of your turn by an amount equal to the ability’s persistent value, which enables the ability’s persistent effect. All your active persistent abilities end at the end of the encounter.

You can’t maintain any abilities that would make you earn a negative amount of essence at the start of your turn. You can stop maintaining an ability at any time (no action required).

If you maintain the same ability on several targets and the effect includes a power roll, you make that roll once and apply the same effect to all targets. A creature can’t be affected by multiple instances of a persistent ability.

If you take damage equal to or greater than 5 times your Reason score in one turn, you stop maintaining any persistent abilities. For instance, if you have a Reason score of 2 and are maintaining Instantaneous Excavation, taking 10 or more damage in one turn causes you to stop maintaining the ability.

ability.name: Practical Magic
ability.description: Your mastery of elemental power lets you customize your conjurations.

args: Self; see below

Choose one of the following effects:

* You use the Knockback maneuver, but its distance becomes the range of your Hurl Element ability, and you use Reason instead of Might for the power roll.
* You choose a creature within the distance of your Hurl Element ability and one of the following damage types: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic. That creature takes damage of the chosen type equal to your Reason score.
* You teleport up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score. If you choose this option, you can spend essence to teleport 1 additional square for each essence spent.

feature.name: Enchantment of Battle
feature.description:
You can wear light armor and wield light weapons effectively, even though you don’t have a kit.

* While you wear light armor, you gain a +3 bonus to Stamina, and that bonus increases by 3 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels.
* While you wield a light weapon, you gain a +1 damage bonus with weapon abilities, including free strikes.
* You can use light armor treasures and light weapon treasures.

If you have a kit, you can’t take this enchantment.

feature.name: Enchantment of Celerity
feature.description: You gain a bonus to speed and to the distance you can shift when you take the Disengage move action.

feature.name: Enchantment of Destruction
feature.description: You gain a bonus to rolled damage with magic abilities.

feature.name: Enchantment of Distance
feature.description: You have a bonus to the distance of your ranged magic abilities.

feature.name: Ward of Delightful Consequences
feature.description: A protective field of void magic absorbs violence aimed at you, then lets you hurl it back at your enemies.

feature.name: Ward of Excellent Protection
feature.description: You weave a shield of all the elements around yourself, channeling their full protective power. You have immunity to acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic damage equal to your Reason score.

ability.name: Ward of Nature's Affection
ability.description: You store green energy within your body that allows you to produce powerful vines when you’re in danger.

args: A creature within a number of squares equal to your Reason score deals damage to you,
You slide the attacking creature up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score.

ability.name: Ward of Surprising Reactivity
ability.description: You use the magic of fire to create a ward of explosive energy.

args: An adjacent creature deals damage to you.
You push that creature a number of squares equal to twice your Reason score.

features.name: Font of Essence
features.trigger: You or a creature within 10 of you takes damage that isn’t untyped or holy

features.name: Wyrding
features.description:
You can spend 10 uninterrupted minutes to create a freeform magic spell for a variety of situations. Choose one of the following magical effects:

* You create a mundane object of a size equal to your Reason score or smaller.
* You construct a place of shelter suitable for twenty creatures that lasts for 24 hours and can’t be detected by enemies.
* You restore all Stamina to a mundane object of a size equal to your Reason score or smaller.
* Choose a cube with a size up to your Reason score within 5 squares. You can fill that area with difficult terrain or natural phenomena such as fire, water, or plant life, or can clear the area of those things.
* You can preserve a corpse or up to 5 pounds of food for a week, or can cause a corpse or that amount of food to instantly rot.
* You create a seal on a surface that can’t be seen or felt by anyone but you. When a creature comes adjacent to the surface, you can see and hear through the seal for as long as the creature remains adjacent to it. When you create the seal, you can decide to limit the number of creatures who activate it by choosing a creature keyword (such as Undead) or a specific name (such as Ajax the Invincible) or organization (such as the Black Iron Pact). If you do, the seal alerts you only when creatures with the keyword, name, or organizational affiliation you provide pass by it. If you create a second seal, the first one disappears. You can dispel a seal at any time (no action required).

features.name: Grand Wyrding
features.description:
You have mastered the magic of shaping a wyrd, and can use your Wyrding feature as a main action.

Additionally, when you have 5 or more Victories, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic. You have immunity all to that type.

features.name: Breath
features.description:
You can spend any number of breath to gain essence (no action required). When you do, 1 breath becomes 3 essence.

Breath remains until you convert it to essence.

abilities.name: Afflict a Bountiful Decay
abilities.description: Your curse causes a foe’s flesh to rot off as spores that aid your allies.

args: Choose yourself or one ally within distance. That character can end one effect on them that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn.

abilities.name: Bifurcated Incineration
abilities.description: Two jets of flame lance out at your command.

abilities.name: Grasp of Beyond
abilities.description: You absorb the life energy of another creature and use it to teleport.

args: You can teleport up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score.

abilities.name: The Green Within, The Green Without
abilities.description: Whipping vines erupt from a foe’s body to grasp at another close by.

args: You slide one creature within 10 squares of the target up to 2 squares.

abilities.name: Meteoric Introduction
abilities.description: You give your enemy a gentle tap - like an asteroid impact.

abilities.name: Ray of Agonizing Self-Reflection
abilities.description: You inflict pain and doubt in equal measure.

sections.tier1: 2 + R corruption damage; R < [weak], slowed (save ends)
sections.tier2: 4 + R corruption damage; R < [average], slowed (save ends)
sections.tier3: 6 + R corruption damage; R < [strong], slowed (save ends)

abilities.name: Unquiet Ground
abilities.description: A sudden storm of detritus assaults your foes and leaves them struggling to move.

args: The ground beneath the area becomes difficult terrain for enemies.

abilities.name: Viscous Fire
abilities.description: A jet of heavy fire erupts where you strike.

abilities.name: Behold the Mystery
abilities.description: You open a rift into the void to harry your foes.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: At the start of your turn, you can use a maneuver to use this ability again without spending essence.

abilities.name: The Flesh, a Crucible
abilities.description: Fire engulfs your target and continues to churn.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: If the target is within distance at the start of your turn, make a power roll for this ability again.

abilities.name: Invigorating Growth
abilities.description: Mushrooms erupt from a foe, sapping their vitality to spread strengthening spores.

args: Mushrooms cover the target’s body. While the mushrooms are on the target, you and any ally adjacent to the target gain 1 surge whenever the target takes damage. The mushrooms can be removed by the target or an adjacent creature as a main action.

abilities.name: Ripples in the Earth
abilities.description: Like a stone dropped into a pond, waves in the earth radiate from you.

args: You must be touching the ground to use this ability. Additionally, you can choose a square of ground in the area that is unoccupied or is occupied by you or any ally. A pillar of earth rises out of the ground in that square, with a height in squares up to your Reason score. The pillar can’t collide with any creatures or objects, nor can it force creatures raised by it to collide with other creatures or objects.

abilities.name: Conflagration
abilities.description: A storm of fire descends upon your enemies.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: At the start of your turn, you can use a maneuver to use this ability again without spending essence.

abilities.name: Instantaneous Excavation
abilities.description: The surface of the world around you opens up at your command.

args: You open up two holes with 1-square openings that are 4 squares deep, which can be placed on any mundane surface within distance. You can place these holes next to each other to create fewer holes with wider openings. When the holes open, make a separate power roll for each creature on the ground above a hole and small enough to fall in. (You can’t score a critical hit with this ability because it uses a maneuver.)

sections.tier1: The target can shift 1 square from the edge of the hole to the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.
sections.tier2: The target falls into the hole.
sections.tier3: The target falls into the hole and can’t reduce the height of the fall.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: At the start of your turn, you open another hole, making a power roll against each creature who could fall into the hole when it opens without spending essence.

abilities.name: No More than a Breeze
abilities.description: The material substance of a creature shreds away at your command.

args: Until the start of your next turn, the target can move through solid matter, they ignore difficult terrain, and their movement can’t provoke opportunity attacks. If the target ends their turn inside solid matter, they are forced out into the space where they entered it and this effect ends.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Test of Rain
abilities.description: You call down a rain that burns your enemies and restores your allies.

args: You can end one effect on yourself that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of your turn. Each ally in the area also gains this benefit.

abilities.name: O Flower Aid, O Earth Defend
abilities.description: Revitalizing plants and jagged stones grow, helping allies and hindering foes.

args:
Until the start of your next turn, the area gains the following effects:

* Once as a free maneuver at the start of your turn, you allow yourself and each ally in the area to spend any number of Recoveries.
* The area is difficult terrain for enemies.
* Each enemy who enters the area for the first time in a combat round or starts their turn there takes damage equal to your Reason score.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The area remains until the start of your next turn. As a maneuver, you can move the area up to 5 squares. This ability ends if the area is ever not within your line of effect.

abilities.name: Subvert the Green Within
abilities.description: Fungal spores sprout inside your enemy’s brain, allowing you to control their actions.

args: The target uses their signature ability against a creature of your choice. This signature ability can target the creature even if it usually wouldn’t. You then make a power roll against the target of this ability.

abilities.name: Translated Through Flame
abilities.description: Your ally disappears, then reappears in a burst of fire!

args: The target is teleported to another space within distance. Make a power roll that affects each enemy adjacent to the target’s new space.

abilities.name: Volcano's Embrace
abilities.description: Wrap them up in fire and melting stone.

sections.tier1: 5 + R fire damage; A < [weak], restrained (save ends)
sections.tier2: 9 + R fire damage; A < [average], restrained (save ends)
sections.tier3: 12 + R fire damage; A < [strong], restrained (save ends)

abilities.name: Erase
abilities.description: With a flick of the wrist, you phase creatures out of existence.

args: The number of creatures you target with this ability is determined by your power roll.

Each target begins to fade from existence (save ends). On their first turn while fading from existence, a target takes a bane on power rolls. At the end of their first turn, they have a double bane on power rolls. At the end of their second turn, they fade from existence for 1 hour, after which they reappear in their original space or the nearest unoccupied space.

abilities.name: Maw of Earth
abilities.description: You open up the ground, unleashing a shower of stone and debris.

args: The ground in or directly beneath the area drops 3 squares.

abilities.name: Swarm of Spirits
abilities.description: Guardian animal spirits surround you to harry your foes and bolster your allies.

args: Until the end of your next turn, each ally in the area has each of their characteristic scores treated as 1 higher for the purpose of resisting potencies, and has a +1 bonus to saving throws.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: You make the power roll again to target each enemy in the area without spending essence, and the effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Wall of Fire
abilities.description: A blazing, beautifully organized inferno erupts at your command.

args: The wall lasts until the start of your next turn, and can be placed in occupied squares. Creatures can enter and pass through the wall. Each enemy who enters the area for the first time in a combat round or starts their turn there takes fire damage equal to your Reason score for each square of the area they start their turn in or enter.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The wall lasts until the start of your next turn, and you can add a number of squares to the wall equal to your Reason score.

abilities.name: Combustion Deferred
abilities.description: Your flames dance from kindling to kindling to kindling.

args: When the target ends their next turn, or if they drop to 0 Stamina before then, each enemy adjacent to them takes fire damage equal to twice your Reason score. Each affected enemy then gains this same effect.

abilities.name: Storm of Sands
abilities.description: Dirt and debris swirl into a dark, pulsing hurricane.

args: The area lasts until the start of your next turn. It is difficult terrain for enemies, and you and your allies have concealment while in the area.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The area remains until the start of your next turn, and you can move it up to 5 squares (no action required). As a maneuver, you can make the power roll again without spending essence.

abilities.name: Subverted Perception of Space
abilities.description: You rip an enemy’s world in twain.

sections.tier2: 10 + R corruption damage; the target has line of effect only to creatures and objects within 4 squares of them until the start of your next turn
sections.tier3: 15 + R corruption damage; the target has line of effect only to adjacent creatures and objects until the start of your next turn

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The target’s limited line of effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Web of All That's Come Before
abilities.description: Threads you’ve been weaving through your adventures create a vibrant, pearlescent web.

args: The area is difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. Each enemy who ends their turn in the area is restrained (save ends).

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The area remains until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Luminous Champion Aloft
abilities.description: They shine vibrantly, a beautiful diamond in the night sky.

args: The target has a +3 bonus to speed, they can fly, and their abilities ignore concealment. Additionally, whenever the target gains their Heroic Resource, they gain 1 additional Heroic Resource. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Magma Titan
abilities.description: Their body swells with lava, mud, and might, towering over their enemies.

args:
Until the start of your next turn, the target has the following benefits:

* Their size and stability increase by 2, with any size 1 target becoming size 3. Each creature who is within the target’s new space slides to the nearest unoccupied space, ignoring stability. If the target doesn’t have space to grow, they grow as much as they can and become restrained until the effect ends.
* They have fire immunity 10.
* Their strikes deal extra fire damage equal to twice your Reason score.
* When the target force moves a creature or object, the forced movement distance gains a +2 bonus.
* They can use their highest characteristic instead of Might for Might power rolls.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The effect lasts until the start of your next turn. Additionally, at the start of your turn, the target can spend 2 Recoveries.

abilities.name: Meteor
abilities.description: You teleport the target into the air and let the ground and the elemental force of fire do the rest.

sections.tier1: You teleport the target up to 4 squares.
sections.tier2: You teleport the target up to 6 squares.
sections.tier3: You teleport the target up to 8 squares.

args: If the target is teleported to a space where they would fall, they immediately do so, treating the fall as if their Agility score were 0. The target takes fire damage from the fall, and each enemy within 3 squares of where they land takes the same amount of fire damage. The ground within 3 squares of where the target lands is difficult terrain.

abilities.name: The Wode Remembers and Returns
abilities.description: You create a terrarium that spans from canopy above to underbrush below.

args: The area becomes dark and verdant, with trees and plant life appearing in unoccupied spaces within it until the start of your next turn. The area is difficult terrain for enemies, and any ally who ends their turn in the area has cover.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The area remains until the start of your next turn. Additionally, at the start of your turn, each ally in the area can spend a Recovery.

abilities.name: Heart of the Wode
abilities.description: You call forth one of the Great Tree’s many splinters to provide for your every need.

args:
A size 5 tree appears in an unoccupied space within distance. The tree has 100 Stamina and can’t be force moved. You and any ally can touch the tree to use the Catch Breath maneuver as a free maneuver. Additionally, when you start your turn with line of effect to the tree, you can end one effect on yourself that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of your turn, or you can stand up if you are prone. Each ally within distance also gains this benefit.

Each enemy who ends their turn within 3 squares of the tree is restrained until the end of their next turn. A creature restrained this way can use a main action to end the effect early.

abilities.name: Muse of Fire
abilities.description: The fire burns hot enough to sear the face of any god watching.

sections.tier1: 7 fire damage; the Director loses 2 Malice
sections.tier2: 10 fire damage; the Director loses 3 Malice
sections.tier3: 15 fire damage; the Director loses 4 Malice

args: The Director’s Malice can become negative as a result of this ability.

abilities.name: Return to Oblivion
abilities.description: You create a tear in reality that could consume everything.

args: You create a size 1L vortex that lasts until the end of the encounter. At the start of each combat round while the vortex is unoccupied, the vortex vertical pulls 3 each enemy within 5 squares of it. Each enemy who enters the vortex or starts their turn there is knocked prone. At the end of the round, if a winded enemy who is not a leader or solo creature is in the vortex, they are instantly destroyed.

abilities.name: World Torn Asunder
abilities.description: You stomp your foot and quake the whole world over.

args: You create a fissure in the ground adjacent to you that is a 10 × 2 line and 6 squares deep. Each creature in the area who is prone and size 2 or smaller falls in. Other creatures can enter the fissure or can shift to the nearest unoccupied space of their choice outside it.

abilities.name: Earth Rejects You
abilities.description: Everyone and everything gets blown away in an eruption of rocks and debris.
abilities.target: Each enemy and object in the area

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: At the start of your turn, you can use a maneuver to use this ability again without spending essence.

abilities.name: The Green Defends Its Servants
abilities.description: A luminous green shield shows its true beauty the more it cracks.

args: You conjure an elemental shield that protects the target until the end of your next turn. While the shield is active, the target can take the Defend main action as a maneuver on each of their turns. The target gains 30 temporary Stamina that lasts until depleted or until the effect ends. If this temporary Stamina disappears, the effect ends and the shield explodes, dealing 10 damage to each enemy within 5 squares of the target

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Prism
abilities.description: You split your essence, allowing you to cast multiple effects at once.

args: You use up to three heroic abilities whose essence costs total 11 or less, spending no additional essence beyond the cost of this ability. You can shift up to 2 squares between your use of each ability.

abilities.name: Unquenchable Fire
abilities.description: You let fly a fiery missile braided with pure primal energy.

sections.tier1: 13 + R fire damage; I < [weak] , dazed (save ends)
sections.tier2: 18 + R fire damage; I < [average] , dazed (save ends)
sections.tier3: 25 + R fire damage; I < [strong] , dazed (save ends)

args: This damage ignores immunity.

subclasses.name: Earth
subclasses.description: Earth is the element of permanence. Earth abilities bolster your body and grant the power to permanently create and shape physical terrain.

features.name: Earth: Acolyte of Earth
features.description: You harness the flow of earth magic to become harder to move. Whenever you use an ability that has the Earth and Magic keywords, your stability increases by 1 until the start of your next turn. This benefit is cumulative.

ability.name: Motivate Earth
ability.description: The earth rises, falls, or opens up at your command.

args:
You touch a square containing mundane dirt, stone, or metal and create a 5 wall of the same material, which rises up out of the ground and must include the square you touched.

Alternatively, you touch a structure made of mundane dirt, stone, or metal that occupies 2 or more squares. You can open a 1-square opening in the structure where you touched it. You can instead touch an existing doorway or other opening that is 1 square or smaller in a mundane dirt, stone, or metal surface. The opening is sealed by the same material that makes up the surface.

ability.name: Skin Like Castle Walls
ability.description: You cover yourself or an ally in protective stone.

args: The target takes damage.
The damage is halved.

sections.effect: If the damage has any potency effect associate with it, the potency is reduced by 1.

features.name: Disciple of Earth
features.description: Your body is strengthened by your mind’s connection to the element of permanence.

ability.name: Earth Accepts Me
ability.description: You can slip into the stone.

args: You step into a mundane dirt, metal, or stone object (including a wall) that is as large as you or larger. You can remain inside the object for as long as you like. While inside the object, you can observe events and speak to creatures outside it, but you don’t have line of effect to anything outside the object and vice versa. You can travel through the object freely until you exit it. If the object you meld with is destroyed, you take 10 damage and exit the object.

features.name: Mantle of Essence: Quaking Earth
features.description:
While you have 3 or more essence and are not dying, you exude an aura of magic whose distance is equal to your Reason score. You can activate and deactivate the aura at will (no action required).

At the end of each of your turns, you can push each enemy in the area up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score.

features.name: The Mountain Does Not Move
features.description:
You stand firm and magnetize your allies to stay grounded. Your stability increases by your level.

Additionally, whenever an ally within distance of your Hurl Element ability is force moved, you can use a free triggered action to decrease your stability down to a minimum of 0, then increase the ally’s stability by an amount equal to the stability you lost. This change lasts until the end of the round.

args: The target is force moved
The distance of your Hurl Element ability
You decrease your stability down to a minimum of 0, then increase the target’s stability by an amount equal to the stability you lost. This change lasts until the end of the round.

features.name: Mantle of Quintessence
features.description:
Your Mantle of Essence feature no longer requires essence.

Additionally, your Mantle of Essence now radiates magic that creates a calming air. Creatures in the area of the mantle’s aura have their starting patience increased by 1 (to a maximum of 5) during any negotiation. While in the area, you and any ally gain an edge on tests that use the Handle Animals skill. If you have 5 or more Victories, the bonus to patience increases to 2 and tests that use the Handle Animals skill have a double edge.

ability.name: Summon Source of Earth
ability.description: The ground rumbles as an elemental bursts forth, ready to serve.

args:
A source of earth emerges from an unoccupied space within distance. The source takes their turn immediately after you, moving up to their speed and either taking a main action or a maneuver. The source is dismissed at the start of your next turn.

The source starts an encounter at full Stamina, but maintains their current Stamina throughout the encounter, even if they are dismissed and you use this ability again. They can’t regain Stamina during the encounter. When the source’s Stamina is reduced to 0, you can’t use this ability again until you earn 1 or more Victories.

sections.name: Persist
sections.effect: The source takes another turn. They are dismissed at the start of your next turn.

features.name: One: Master of Earth
features.description:
You become the embodiment of the element of your chosen specialization. Whenever you use magic, elemental motes flit around you and your skin changes to reflect your element, taking on an earthen or stony appearance for earth, appearing like flickering flame for fire, gaining a leaf pattern for green, and becoming a starry expanse for void.

You have damage immunity 5.

Additionally, as a respite activity, you can shape the mundane earth around you in a 1-mile radius. You can open sinkholes, form mountains, level mundane structures or whole settlements, create canyons, raise islands or sink them in the sea, and perform similar feats. You can’t use this respite activity if another creature within 1 mile is already using it. Once you use this respite activity, you can’t use it again for 10 days.

subclasses.name: Fire
subclasses.description: Fire is the element of destruction. Fire abilities devastate enemies and melt objects to slag.

features.name: Acolyte of Fire
features.description: Your abilities with both the Fire and Magic keywords gain +1 rolled damage. Hurl Element also gains this bonus when you use it to deal fire damage.

ability.name: Return to Formlessness
ability.description: With the merest touch, you cause an object to turn into slag or ash.

args: You heat the target and cause it to melt or combust, destroying it. If the object is larger than 1 square, then only the square of the object you touch is destroyed.

ability.name: Explosive Assistance
ability.description: You add a little magic to an ally’s aggression at just the right time.

args: The target force moves a creature or object.
The forced movement distance gains a bonus equal to your Reason score.

sections.effect: The forced movement distance gains a bonus equal to twice your Reason score instead.

features.name: Disciple of Fire
features.description:
Your connection to fire allows you to protect yourself from it, even as you rip away the protections of others. You have fire immunity equal to 5 plus your level. Additionally, fire damage you deal ignores a target’s fire immunity.

At the start of a combat encounter, you gain a number of surges equal to your Victories. Whenever you spend a surge to deal extra damage, you can make that damage fire damage.

features.name: A Conversation with Fire
features.description: When you spend 1 uninterrupted minute in front of a fire, you can speak the name of another creature. If that creature is willing to speak to you, their image appears in the fire, and they can see you before them in a shimmering ball of light. The two of you can speak to each other through these images as if you were together in person. As a maneuver, you or the creature can end the conversation.

features.name: Mantle of Essence: Burning Grounds
features.description:
While you have 3 or more essence and are not dying, you exude an aura of magic whose distance is equal to your Reason score. You can activate and deactivate the aura at will (no action required).

At the end of each of your turns, each enemy in the area takes fire damage equal to your Reason score.

features.name: Smoldering Step
features.description:
You can use 1 square of movement to walk into an area of fire your size or larger and teleport to any other area of fire your size or larger within 10 squares of the first area.

Additionally, whenever you use a fire ability or are targeted by an ability that deals fire damage, each enemy adjacent to you takes fire damage equal to your Reason score.

features.name: Mantle of Quintessence
features.description:
Your Mantle of Essence feature no longer requires essence.

Additionally, your Mantle of Essence now radiates magic that creates a calming air. Creatures in the area of the mantle’s aura have their starting patience increased by 1 (to a maximum of 5) during any negotiation. While in the area, you and any ally gain an edge on tests that use the Handle Animals skill. If you have 5 or more Victories, the bonus to patience increases to 2 and tests that use the Handle Animals skill have a double edge.

features.name: The Flame Primordial
features.description:
You produce a fire that entrances the fates, distracting them from aiding your foes. Whenever you deal fire damage to a creature or object, they take an extra 1d6 fire damage. If you deal fire damage to a mundane object, you can use a free triggered action to target it with your Return to Formlessness ability instead.

Additionally, any enemy who starts their turn adjacent to you has fire weakness equal to your Reason score until the start of their next turn. This increases to twice your Reason score if the enemy is made of or is wearing mostly metal.

features.name: One: Master of Fire
features.description:
You become the embodiment of the element of your chosen specialization. Whenever you use magic, elemental motes flit around you and your skin changes to reflect your element, taking on an earthen or stony appearance for earth, appearing like flickering flame for fire, gaining a leaf pattern for green, and becoming a starry expanse for void.

The damage bonus of your Acolyte of Fire feature increases to +5 and applies to all your magic abilities.

Additionally, your Return to Formlessness ability can be used on supernatural objects (but not on artifacts). When you melt a treasure, you gain breath equal to its echelon.

subclasses.name: Green
subclasses.description: Green is the element of creation and growth. Green abilities make and manipulate plants, fungi, and other forms of life to hamper foes and nourish your allies.

features.name: Acolyte of the Green
features.description: You harness the residual magic from your green spells to bolster yourself and your allies. Whenever you deal damage to one or more creatures using an ability that has the Green and Magic keywords and that costs essence to use (see below), you or one creature within 10 squares of you gains temporary Stamina equal to your Reason score.

features.name: It Is the Soul Which Hears
features.description:
You can speak with and understand animals, beasts, and plant creatures, even if they don’t share a language with you. Your ability to communicate with these creatures doesn’t make them inherently more intelligent, but you can use Reason instead of Presence while making tests to influence them.

Additionally, you can touch a living plant that is not a plant creature to communicate with it telepathically. You can use words to communicate with the plant, but it communicates with you only by transmitting feelings and sensations that can’t be overly specific.

ability.name: Breath of Dawn Remembered
ability.description: The power you channel grants the ability to get back in the fight.

args: The target starts their turn or takes damage.
The target can spend a Recovery.

sections.effect: The target can spend an additional Recovery for each essence spent.

features.name: Disciple of the Green
features.description:
You can use a maneuver to shapeshift into a type of creature on the Green Animal Forms table. While in animal form, you can speak, and you use your Reason score to make melee free strikes. Your statistics stay the same except as noted on the table.

Each form has a prerequisite level that you must attain before you can adopt it. Some animal forms grant you temporary Stamina. You lose this temporary Stamina when you revert back to your true form.

You choose a specific animal and appearance while in animal form. For example, if you become a rodent, you might become a mouse, a rat, a shrew, or any other size 1T animal who fits the rodent type. When you take on an animal form, your equipment either melds into your new form or falls undamaged to the ground (your choice). When you return to your true form, any melded gear reappears on your person.

You can revert back to your true form as a maneuver. You can’t enter an animal form unless you are in your true form. When you are dying, you revert to your true form and can’t turn back into an animal until you are no longer dying.

ability.name: Remember Growth and Sun and Rain
ability.description: You stir any wood’s memory and learn what it has seen.

args: You see and hear any events that have occurred within 10 squares of the object within the last 12 hours, perceiving those events from the object’s location as if you were there.

features.name: Mantle of Essence: Flowering Bed
features.description:
While you have 3 or more essence and are not dying, you exude an aura of magic whose distance is equal to your Reason score. You can activate and deactivate the aura at will (no action required).

At the end of each of your turns, each ally in the area gains temporary Stamina equal to your Reason score.

features.name: Hide of Tenfold Shields
features.description:
Your animal forms become hardier. You gain temporary Stamina equal to your level when you enter an animal form in combat, which is added to any temporary Stamina provided by the animal form.

Additionally, an adjacent ally can use a maneuver to pet you. If they do so, you can lose temporary Stamina down to a minimum of 0. The ally gains temporary Stamina equal to the amount you lost.

features.name: Mantle of Quintessence
features.description:
Your Mantle of Essence feature no longer requires essence.

Additionally, your Mantle of Essence now radiates magic that creates a calming air. Creatures in the area of the mantle’s aura have their starting patience increased by 1 (to a maximum of 5) during any negotiation. While in the area, you and any ally gain an edge on tests that use the Handle Animals skill. If you have 5 or more Victories, the bonus to patience increases to 2 and tests that use the Handle Animals skill have a double edge.

features.name: Chimeric Manifestation
features.description:
Nature isn’t static and unchanging, and neither are you. You can enter or exit your animal form as a free maneuver the first time you use your Disciple of the Green feature on your turn.

Additionally, whenever you use your Disciple of the Green feature, you can select an additional animal form and gain the positive benefits from both forms. You can choose the size of either animal, and if both animal forms grant you the same benefit, you can choose whichever you prefer. You gain the highest speed between the two animal forms and have all types of movement from both forms.

You can only combine animal forms whose levels add up to 12 or less. For example, you can combine a shark (8th level) with a horse (4th level), but you can’t combine a shark with a bear (5th level).

features.name: One: Master of Green
features.description:
You become the embodiment of the element of your chosen specialization. Whenever you use magic, elemental motes flit around you and your skin changes to reflect your element, taking on an earthen or stony appearance for earth, appearing like flickering flame for fire, gaining a leaf pattern for green, and becoming a starry expanse for void.

The number of Recoveries you have increases by 2, and each time you finish a respite, you can grant each ally who finished the respite with you 2 additional Recoveries. Your allies’ additional Recoveries disappear when they finish their next respite.

Additionally, as a respite activity, you can perform a ritual that causes a fruit tree to spring from the ground, grow, mature, and produce 1d6 of a treasure called Life Fruit. You can use a respite activity to cause an existing tree to produce another 1d6 Life Fruit, but it does not grow these magic consumables on its own.

As a maneuver, a creature can consume a Life Fruit or feed it to an adjacent willing ally. When a creature eats a Life Fruit, they restore all their Stamina, they can end all conditions or effects on themself, and they can stand up if prone. Additionally, if the creature desires, their aging pauses for 1d10 years. If the creature eats additional Life Fruit and chooses to pause their aging, the effects don’t stack. Instead, the creature gains the benefit from the Life Fruit that pauses their aging for the longest time.

subclasses.name: Void
subclasses.description: Void is the element of the mystery. Void abilities warp space and reality, allowing you to teleport, create illusions, and make things incorporeal.

features.name: A Beyonding of Vision
features.description: You instantly recognize illusions for what they are, you can see invisible creatures, and supernatural effects can’t conceal creatures and objects from you. Additionally, you always know if an area or object you observe is magical or affected by magic, and you know the specifics of what that magic can do.

ability.name: Shared Void Sense
ability.description: You grant allies a taste of your unearthly vision.

args: For each Victory you have, you can target one creature. Each target gains the benefit of your A Beyonding of Vision feature until the end of your next turn, but doesn’t gain the use of the Shared Void Sense ability.

ability.name: Subtle Relocation
ability.description: You call on the void to swallow and spit out an ally.

args: The target starts their turn, moves, or is force moved.
You teleport the target up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score. If the target moves to trigger this ability, you can teleport them at any point during the move.

sections.effect: You teleport the target up to a number of squares equal to twice your Reason score instead.

ability.name: There is No Space Between
ability.description: Knowledge of the mystery reveals that two spaces are the same space.

args:
You open two size 1 portals in unoccupied spaces within distance, which last until you move beyond distance from any portal, end the effect as a maneuver, or are dying. Each portal must be placed at a height of no more than 1 square above the ground. When you or any ally touch a portal, that creature can choose to be instantly teleported to an unoccupied space of their choice adjacent to the other portal. If an enemy is force moved into a portal, their forced movement ends and they emerge from the other portal in an unoccupied space chosen by the creature who force moved them.

At the start of each of your turns while the portals are active, you can open a new portal connected to the others. If three or more portals are present, you and your allies choose which portal to emerge from when entering a portal, and a creature who force moves an enemy into a portal chooses that enemy’s destination portal.

features.name: Distance is Only Memory
features.description: Each time you finish a respite, you can open a two-way portal that leads to any place you have previously been. You and your allies can pass through the portal, which remains open for 1 hour or until you dismiss it as a main action.

features.name: Mantle of Essence: Veiling Bed
features.description:
While you have 3 or more essence and are not dying, you exude an aura of magic whose distance is equal to your Reason score. You can activate and deactivate the aura at will (no action required).

The area provides concealment for you and your allies.

features.name: Pierce the Veil of Substance
features.description:
Solidity is merely a suggestion to you. Mundane barriers that are 1 square thick or less do not block your senses or line of effect. You can only sense or have line of effect past one such barrier at a time.

Additionally, whenever you use a void ability, you or one ally within distance of the ability can teleport a number of squares equal to your Reason score.

features.name: Mantle of Quintessence
features.description:
Your Mantle of Essence feature no longer requires essence.

Additionally, your Mantle of Essence now radiates magic that creates a calming air. Creatures in the area of the mantle’s aura have their starting patience increased by 1 (to a maximum of 5) during any negotiation. While in the area, you and any ally gain an edge on tests that use the Handle Animals skill. If you have 5 or more Victories, the bonus to patience increases to 2 and tests that use the Handle Animals skill have a double edge.

features.name: Black Hole Star
features.description:
You warp gravity around your heavenly body and can pull even the sturdiest titans toward your core. At the end of each of your turns, you target one creature or object within distance of your Hurl Element ability and vertical pull that target up to 5 squares. If their stability reduces this forced movement, they are pulled a minimum of 2 squares. This forced movement ignores stability for your allies.

Additionally, your Mantle of Essence improves. While in the area of the aura, enemies and objects have their stability reduced by an amount equal to your level.

features.name: One: Master of Void
features.description:
You become the embodiment of the element of your chosen specialization. Whenever you use magic, elemental motes flit around you and your skin changes to reflect your element, taking on an earthen or stony appearance for earth, appearing like flickering flame for fire, gaining a leaf pattern for green, and becoming a starry expanse for void.

Whenever you willingly move, you can teleport.

Additionally, your mind is connected to the mystery and helps you find the answers you seek. You no longer require project sources for research projects. Whenever you use a respite activity to make a project roll for a research project, you automatically complete the project.
